text:
Remember, RAID is not a backup. Also /backups/ directory on the same bare metal server is not backup. Your verified backup must be offsite with a 3-2-1 policy. Do you know how much time it takes to restore your data? If not, find out. DR is a serious business.

name: Andi
text:
always set up automatic database backups

make sure they’re stored on a different server and actually test if you can restore them

a backup is useless if it doesn’t work when you need it

hope for the best, prepare for the worst :)

name: Florian Roth ⚡️
text:

The good news is that it comes with a default config for sshd, which prevents the exploitation of CVE-2024-6387 & brute force attacks in general

@digitalocean has a tutorial
https://t.co/PeA8ynroxV

name: Josh Schultz
text:
Someone just migrated from DigitalOcean to Hetzner.

Same production workload. 30 MySQL databases. 248GB of data. Hundreds of thousands of users.

Bill went from $1,432/month to $233/month.

New machine is MORE powerful. 96 CPUs. 256GB DDR5. NVMe RAID.

$14,388 saved per year.
